subtitle: Live scores, standings and statistics of teams and players. Study the league, not just the score.

freeBand.title: All free, for everyone.
freeBand.description: Scores, statistics and xG with no subscription. Sign in with the same GiBiArena account to save your favourite teams.

live.title: Scores and live
live.text: Today's matches in real time. Tap a match for the commentary, lineups and statistics; the star keeps your favourite teams and competitions at the top.

predictions.title: Predictions and betting slips
predictions.text: For every match three picks from the model, cautious, recommended and bold, checked against the results. One button builds a betting slip with the stake split by column.

fantasy.title: Fantasy football
fantasy.text: A guided auction with recommended ratings and credits, then every week the best lineup for your squad. Three steps: set up, record the purchases, field the team.
